[RBND.4b.8] **Encoding independence.** The canonical
serialization of [RBND.4b.2] is defined over the **logical**
contract — the fully expanded, ascending
`(node_id, kind, capacity)` list — regardless of whether the
`RealtimeContract` atom stores that list in the legacy `nodes`
form or the compact form of [RTCT.6.7]. A producer or runtime
computing or verifying `rt_config_sha256` MUST first
**materialize the logical list**: enumerate covered nodes in
ascending `node_id` order ([RTCT.6.7.2]), take each node's
`kind` from its `AlphaNode`/`BetaNode`/`TerminalNode` atom
(`"alpha"`/`"beta"`/`"term"`), and its capacity from the
resolved encoding ([RTCT.6.7.3] / [RTCT.6.7.4]); then serialize
and hash per [RBND.4b.2]. Consequently a legacy and a compact
encoding of the same contract produce the **same**
`rt_config_sha256`, and the `DscHeader` binding ([RDSC.3.8]) holds
across both. The compact encoding therefore requires **no**
re-hash or migration of existing artifacts, and a recompiled
bundle that switches encodings keeps an identical hash.
